# Respond.io

AI-powered customer conversation management software.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/respond-io/.

## Actions

- **Add internal comment to conversation**: Add a comment (internal note) to a contact's conversation.
- **Add internal comment to conversation**: Add a comment (internal note) to a contact's conversation.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in the workspace.
- **Create Space Tag**: Create a new tag in the workspace.
- **Get Message**: Retrieve a specific message.
- **List channels**: Retrieve a list of channels connected to the workspace.
- **List users**: Retrieve a list of users in the workspace.
- **Update Space Tag**: Update an existing tag in the workspace.
